thread:
eli: Heads-up — around 11:03 UTC we saw sustained token queue growth in ap-southeast-1. p99 latency for small gen spiked. Starting this thread to capture actions + runbook changes.

maya: confirming. queue_depth ↑, KV cache hit steady, packet drops ~0.4% on ToR in cluster-9.

raj: saw a bunch of NACKs from the autoscaler when we hit ~75% reserved GPU. Autoscale didn't provision extra nodes — looks like API rate limiting or retry logic.

ops-bot: Incident alert: ap-southeast-1 queue_alert triggered by alerting@infra. Run ID r-6312.

tori: manual mitigation: shifted ~20% traffic to us-east-1 via weighted routing at 11:10 UTC — latency recovered to normal there.

kevin: cost note — the us-east burst increased spend by ~12% for that hour. Need cost guardrails for automated failovers.

eli: outcome for postmortem: update failover playbook to include autoscaler preflight checks, node bootstrap sanity, and a cost circuit breaker before automated shifts.

maya: suggested runbook change: add pre-shift checks for `reserved_gpu_utilization` and `autoscaler_rate_limit_remaining` + quick healthcheck for edge network ACLs.

raj: also add a check for node bootstrap time distribution — yesterday bootstrap p90 hit 4.2m vs expected <2m which impacted recovery.

tori: can we add an automated dry-run for traffic shifts that doesn't route billable traffic? use internal test tokens or a shadow route to validate the path.

maya: we have internal dev tokens but we need a sandbox endpoint on the prod edge; that will need a short security checklist.

kevin: action: implement cost-aware shift policy — if projected cost_delta > 8% abort and page SRE lead instead of automatic shift.

eli: assigning owners: maya -> runbook edits + PR by Fri EOD; raj -> autoscaler preflight tests + bootstrap telemetry; kevin -> cost policy + console telemetry; tori -> dry-run plan + security checklist.

ops-bot: Action logged: AP-OUT-1785201234 created in incidents tracker, assignees set.

maya: Draft runbook snippet (pasting):
```
# Pre-shift checks
- check autoscaler API: `curl -s https://autoscaler.internal/api/quota` expect > 1000
- check reserved_gpu_utilization: `promql: reserved_gpu_utilization < 0.85`
- check node bootstrap p90 < 3m
- verify edge ACLs and packet-drop < 0.5%
```
Will open PR against infra/runbooks.

raj: I'll add a lightweight health-check endpoint for nodes to report bootstrap progress and GPU driver init. Quick patch to follow.

tori: playbook note: use "weighted shift with reserve" pattern — keep 10% headroom in the origin region to avoid full depletion during cascading failures.

kevin: :thumbsup: add projected cost delta to the shift approval modal in Console so on-call can see the dollar impact before approving.

eli: drill: schedule a 30-min runbook exercise next Tue 17:00 UTC to validate the new checks, dry-run, and rollback flow.

maya: noted — I'll schedule and invite eng-sre + eng-runtime + security.

raj: follow-ups: add unit tests for autoscaler client, create a manual rollback knob for weighted routing, and add alerting for bootstrap p90 spikes.

tori: can someone add ETAs to the incident issue so PM/PL can triage? need PL signoff for sandbox endpoint.

kevin: ETA: cost policy by Wed EOD. Sandbox endpoint: pending security review, estimate ~7 days.

eli: thanks everyone — update the incident tracker with PR/issue links and we'll close this thread once changes are merged and the drill is scheduled.
